Aboutcontent.aboutusparaone: Andhra Pradesh Innovation Society (APIS) was set up in the year 2015 and registered under the provisions of Andhra Pradesh Societies Registration Act, 2001 is the State Nodal Agency for promoting the growth of Innovation, Entrepreneurship, and Startup Ecosystem in the state
Aboutcontent.aboutusparatwo: AP Innovation Society (APIS) through its Startup Andhra Pradesh Portal assisting the Startups, Incubators, Accelerators, Mentors, Investors/Venture Capitalists along with the other Ecosystem Stakeholders and Enablers for building a vibrant ecosystem and contributing significantly for the development of the State.

Incubation.incubationparaone: Start-ups have got a vital role to play in the future of India by creating innovative solutions to country’s challenging issues and also by generating large-scale job opportunities for upcoming workforce. The Government of Andhra Pradesh has recognised the importance of start-ups in the economic development of both the State and the Nation therefore has come up with subsided incubation facilities for the start-ups.
Incubation.incubationparatwo: The Start-ups can avail our incubation facilities located at Vishakhapatnam, Kakinada, Tirupati, Tadepalli/ Vijayawada at a subsided rate. Apart from the spacious infrastructure, Air-conditioned rooms, Wi-Fi & uninterrupted power and internet facilities the start-ups will also get additional support like access to initial seed funding, network and linkages, mentoring and advisory support.
Incubation.incubationparathree: To avail incubation space at any of our designated locations the start-ups must be registered with Startup Andhra Pradesh Portal and complete the Startup Andhra Pradesh Recognition process.
Incubation.incubationparafour: The process of selection of Start-ups for availing the incubation space is as follows: -
Incubation.exemption1: The above stated procedure is exempted for those Start-ups if they fulfill any one of the below listed criteria by dully submitting the requisite proofs.
Incubation.exemption2: Start-up of any state having valid DPIIT registration intending to operate from Andhra Pradesh.
Incubation.exemption3: Start-ups selected and placed at the top 03 positions in any of the National/International Innovation Challenges/ Hackathons/ Central Government Funding/ Schemes intending to start/operate from Andhra Pradesh.
Incubation.exemption4: Women led-startups with DPIIT Registration/APIS Recognition/participated/ shortlisted in any of the Regional/ National/ International Innovation Challenges/ Hackathons/ Central Government Funding/ Schemes intending to start/operate from Andhra Pradesh.

Publicprocurement.publicprocurementparaone: Institutional, Marketing, Financial and Business Facilitation are the pillars to develop the Start-ups however many Startups struggle in the early stages because of lack of market access for their products. In order to strengthen the startup movement in the state and to make Andhra Pradesh a self-reliant start-up and innovation hub by promoting an innovation driven start-up ecosystem the Government of Andhra Pradesh has given a major relaxation in the norms in Public Procurement of goods and services to bring the startups at par with established entrepreneurs and companies.
Publicprocurement.publicprocurementparatwo: Following relaxations to the Startups registered with AP Innovation Society (APIS) through DPIIT Registration/ Startup Andhra Pradesh Portal for public procurements that are up to Rs. 50.00 Lakh (Rupees Fifty Lakh) in value subject to the condition that the Startups meet the other quality and technical specifications as part of qualifying requirements of the procurements. The relaxations provided to the Startups are Sector agonistic and applicable to all the Startups irrespective of their domains.
Publicprocurement.exemption1: Exemption from payment of Earnest Money Deposit (EMD)
Publicprocurement.exemption2: Exemption from the condition of prior turnover
Publicprocurement.exemption3: Exemption from the condition of Prior Experience

Nodalagency.nodalagencyparaone: Andhra Pradesh Innovation Society (APIS) was set up in 2015 under the AP Societies Registration Act, 2001 functioning under the administrative control of Information Technology, Electronics & Communications (ITE&C) Department, GoAP has been designated as the State Nodal Agency for promoting the growth of innovation, entrepreneurship, and startups by providing an appropriate platform to entrepreneurs, researchers, students, citizens, and the government who can contribute significantly to the development of the State.
Nodalagency.nodalagencyparatwo: Andhra Pradesh was one of the pioneering states in India to devise a dedicated policy for building a strong and inclusive ecosystem for innovation and entrepreneurship in the state.
Nodalagency.function1: To create policies, frameworks, guidelines, set up a mechanisms and process for startups, incubators, mentors, service providers, partner institutions, investors, funding bodies etc, and to enable a conducive startups ecosystem in the state
Nodalagency.function2: To appropriate support and handhold startups and other stakeholders during entire registration and recognition process.
Nodalagency.function3: To develop a mechanism for the stakeholders to get in touch with each other i.e. startups, incubators, mentors, investors, service providers, partner institutions, investors, funding bodies etc.
Nodalagency.function4: To guide and support all key stakeholders in the startup ecosystem.
Nodalagency.function5: To resolve the issues and grievances faced by startups and stakeholders in Startup Andhra Pradesh Portal.
Nodalagency.function6: To coordinate with departments in state government and helping startups in getting the requisite support and suitable facilities from them
Nodalagency.function7: To review and monitor the startup ecosystem in the state and suggest the changes in policy, and guidelines.
Nodalagency.function8: To Provide Access to market reports and surveys for early stage startups.
Nodalagency.function9: A fund of funds of INR 100 Cr. shall be co-created in partnership with a consortium of Venture Capitals and Private Equity firms and universities, for funding startups in the State.
Nodalagency.function10: To establish Centers of Excellences in emerging and industry 4.0 Technologies.
Nodalagency.nodaldepartmentpara: Information Technology, Electronics & Communications (ITE&C) Department is the Nodal Department for supporting the development of startup innovation ecosystem in the state of Andhra Pradesh.
Nodalagency.statenodalofficercontent: The Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of APIS has been deployed as the State Nodal Officer for overseeing the implementation of the Innovation and Startup Policy.

Startupdefinition.startupcontent1: Any entisy willing to get recognized as a startup in Andhra Pradesh shall fulfill all thebelow-mentioned eligibility criteria
Startupdefinition.startupcontent2: The Startup should be an entity incorporated as
Startupdefinition.startupli1: A private limited company (as per the Companies Act 2013) OR
Startupdefinition.startupli2: Registered as a partnership firm (under the Partnership Act, 1932) OR
Startupdefinition.startupli3: A limited liability partnership (under the Limited Liability Partnership Act, 2008) OR
Startupdefinition.startupli4: One Person Company (under Section 2 (62) of the Companies Act, 2013) OR
Startupdefinition.startupli5: Sole Proprietorship with Udyog Aadhaar under the Ministry of MSME/ GST registration inAndhra Pradesh OR
Startupdefinition.startupli6: The startup should have been incorporated/registered in Andhra Pradesh or should operatefrom Andhra Pradesh and employs at least 75 percent of its workforce from Andhra Pradeshwith valid Labour License registered with Government of Andhra Pradesh AND
Startupdefinition.startupli7: An entity shall be considered as a startup up to 10 years from the date of itsincorporation AND
Startupdefinition.startupli8: Turnover should be less than INR 100 Crores in any of the previous financial years AND
Startupdefinition.startupli9: Such an entity should not be an extension of existing family business; or formed bysplitting up or reconstruction of a business already in existence AND
Startupdefinition.startupli10: The Startup should be working towards innovation / improvement of existing products,services and processes and should have the potential to generate employment / createwealth
Startupdefinition.startupli11: An entity formed by splitting up or reconstruction of an existing business shall not beconsidered a Startup
Startupdefinition.innercontent: This is the broad definition for registering/recognizing the startups in Andhra Pradesh which isintended to support spur innovation and entrepreneurship ecosystem across the State. However weencourage startups from Andhra Pradesh to follow Government of India (GOI) norms that define astartup to leverage and access benefits and incentives offered by GOI. In case, if any entity has already registered/recognised as startup by Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) having its registration address from any of the districts in Andhra Pradesh then that particular startup is automatically deemed to be recognised as Andhra Pradesh Startup.

Faqs.question1: What is Startup Andhra Pradesh Portal?
Faqs.answer1: Startup Andhra Pradesh Portal maintained and operated by AP Innovation Society which is the State Nodal Agency for spurring the Startup Ecosystem in the state. The Startup Andhra Pradesh Portal (SAAP) is a one-stop platform for all stakeholders like Startups, Incubators, Mentors, Investors and aspiring entrepreneurs in the Startup ecosystem to interact amongst each other, exchange knowledge and form successful partnerships in a highly dynamic environment.
Faqs.question2: What qualifies as a “Startup” to be part of Startup Andhra Pradesh?
Faqs.answer2: An entity shall be considered as a Startup on fulfilling the conditions defined by Government of India, vide notification No. G.S.R. 364(E) dated April 11, 2018 as modified vide Gazette Notification No. G.S.R. 34(E) dated January 16, 2019 (and as may be amended from time to time). In this notification, an entity shall be considered as a Startup:
Faqs.point1: Upto a period of ten years from the date of incorporation/ registration, if it is incorporated as a private limited company (as defined in the Companies Act, 2013) or registered as a partnership firm (registered under section 59 of the Partnership Act, 1932) or a limited liability partnership (under the Limited Liability Partnership Act, 2008) in India.
Faqs.point2: Turnover of the entity for any of the financial years since incorporation/registration has not exceeded one hundred crore rupees.
Faqs.point3: Entity is working towards innovation, development or improvement of products or processes or services, or if it is a scalable business model with a high potential of employment generation or wealth creation.
Faqs.point4: Provided that an entity formed by splitting up or reconstruction of an existing business shall not be considered a ‘Startup’.
Faqs.question3: Does the Startup need to register with Andhra Pradesh to be part of Startup Andhra Pradesh?
Faqs.answer3: There is no need for the Startups registered and recognised under DPIIT to again register in the Startup Andhra Pradesh Portal. Startup Andhra Pradesh Portal has done the API Integration with Startup India therefore the Startups registered with Startup India with a valid DPIIT Registration can login with their existing user id and password.
Faqs.question4: What are the eligibility criteria for DPIIT RECOGNITION?
Faqs.answer4: An entity is considered for DPIIT recognition on the following criteria:
Faqs.answer5A: Certificate of Incorporation or Registration of entity
Faqs.answer5B: If the startup received any funding, the Proof of Funding need to furnish for DPIIT Certificate of Recognition for Startups
Faqs.answer5C: Document of awards or recognition received by the entity
Faqs.answer5D: Document of the patent published by the entity (The patent should be published in the patent journals)
Faqs.answer5E: A brief description of the nature of the business. The write-up should contain the following details:
Faqs.innerlist1: Details of how the startup is working towards innovation
Faqs.innerlist2: Development of products or processes or services
Faqs.innerlist3: The scalability in terms of employment generation or wealth creation
Faqs.question6: Does the Startup needs to engage/require expert/consultant/ agency for submitting the DPIIT Registration?
Faqs.answer6: There is no need to seek any guidance/assistance from any outsider/agency for submitting the Startup Application for DPIIT Registration/Recognition. If your startup is yet to be registered please follow the link for registering:
Faqs.question7: Other than Startups who all can be registered with Startup Andhra Pradesh Portal (SAPP)?
Faqs.answer7: Through the Startup Andhra Pradesh Portal Mentors, Incubators/Accelerators of both State Funded/ Private funded, Investors can register in the Portal. The system is build to connect you to your relevant stakeholders based on your industry and preferred stage. Under the profile of every enabler there will be an option to “connect/apply”. Upon clicking, a request will be sent to the respective profile for acceptance. Once accepted, you will able to see the enabler as a new connection.
Faqs.question8: Whom to be reached for submitting the Grievance?
Faqs.answer8: In case if you have any questions or concerns you may call us to our helpline number +91 7396603335 on all working days from 10:00 AM - 05:00 PM
Faqs.answer8part1: For further simplifying the process you may please submit your grievance via online in our website
Faqs.answer8part2: To track the status of your grievance submitted with the Tracking Application Number (TAN) from the link given below
Faqs.question9: How do I get my Tracking Application Number (TAN)?
Faqs.answer9: Upon the submission of your grievance successfully there will be pop up alert stating that the confirmation of grievance application submission with a Tracking Application Number. The same will also be sent to the email id submitted while filling the contact details. With this Tracking Application Number (TAN) the users may check their grievance status.
Faqs.question10: How many days does it take to address grievances submitted online?
Faqs.answer10: We are committed to addressing all grievances received online within 07 days. However, if the grievance pertains to policy-related or scheme-related aspects, then those grievances will be resolved within 30 days.
Faqs.answer10part1: In any case, all grievances submitted via the Startup Andhra Pradesh Portal will be
Faqs.answer10part2: addressed and resolved within 30 working days.
Faqs.question11: Is there a Nodal Officer or a Single Point of Contact available from the State to further escalate the queries that are not resolved via online?
Faqs.answer11: You may reach the nodal officer assigned for answering the queries for the startups is The Chief Executive Officer of AP Innovation Society (APIS), Government of Andhra Pradesh.
